explication: ExCrypto is an Elixir wrapper around Erlang crypto, providing symmetric AES operations, random bytes and hashes, HMAC-signed expiring tokens, and RSA key management and operations. Users call these APIs to generate keys or load PEM keys, then encrypt/decrypt data, sign/verify messages, or create/verify tokens. Groups distinguish these domains and their supporting primitives. The graph reflects the supplied excerpts and README; some key and entropy implementation details were not sampled, so their internal relationships are omitted.
